records.jp: 外傷なし、ケガではない……！^00ってことは、おちゅーしゃですね！^00はい、任せてくださ……え、ちがう……？
records.en_original: No wounds, no injuries... Then you must be here to get a shot! No problem, just let me... Oh, you're not?
records.en_auxiliary: No wounds, no injuries? Then you must be here to get a shot! No problem, just let me... Oh, you're not?
records.en: No wounds, no injuries... Then you must be here to get a shot! No problem, just let me... Oh, you're not?

records.jp: はい、おちゅーしゃですか！？^00え、ああ、特に用はない……。^00そうですか……
records.en_original: Okay, are you here for your shots?! Oh, I see, you're here for something else... Disappointing...
records.en_auxiliary: Okay, are you here for your shots?! Oh, I see, you're here for something else. Disappointing...
records.en: Okay, are you here for your shots?! Oh, I see, you're here for something else... Disappointing...

records.jp: あのですね。^00私、お医者様になりたいんです！^00……そうすればおちゅーしゃし放題ですし
records.en_original: You have no idea how much I want to become a doctor! ...That way, I can give as many shots as I want!
records.en_auxiliary: You have no idea how much I want to become a doctor! That way, I can give as many shots as I want!
records.en: You have no idea how much I want to become a doctor! ...That way, I can give as many shots as I want!

records.jp: し、知ってますよ！？^00保健委員はおちゅーしゃできないことくらい^00もちろん知ってますよ！？
records.en_original: O-Of course I know that a health associate is not allowed to give shots! What made you think otherwise...!
records.en_auxiliary: O-of course I know that students on the health committee aren't allowed to give shots! What made you think otherwise?!
records.en: O-Of course I know that a health associate is not allowed to give shots! What made you think otherwise...!

records.jp: 知ったときには……^00ちょっとがっかりしましたけど
records.en_original: Though I must admit, I was a little disappointed when I first found out.
records.en_auxiliary: Though I must admit, I was a little disappointed when I first found out.
records.en: Though I must admit, I was a little disappointed when I first found out.

records.jp: ふふ、どうしたの？^00どこか痛いところでもある？^00無理したらダメだからね？
records.en_original: Oh, tell me what happened. Are you hurting somewhere? It's not good to just work through the pain.
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, tell me what happened. Are you hurting somewhere? It's not good to just work through the pain.
records.en: Oh, tell me what happened. Are you hurting somewhere? It's not good to just work through the pain.

records.jp: ふふ、私も歴戦の保健委員だからね。^00ちょっとしたケガの手当てくらいなら^00任せてくれて平気だよ
records.en_original: Oh, me? I've been a school nurse for some time now. You can count on me to treat any minor injuries you might have.
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, me? I've been on the health committee for some time. You can count on me to treat any minor injuries you might have.
records.en: Oh, me? I've been a school nurse for some time now. You can count on me to treat any minor injuries you might have.

records.jp: 保健委員って地味に忙しいんだよね。^00でも、みんなのために働いてるわけだから^00やりがいはあるんだよ
records.en_original: The life of a school nurse is a busy one, but you're taking care of everyone. There's no better motivation.
records.en_auxiliary: Life on the health committee is busy, but you're taking care of everyone. There's no better motivation.
records.en: The life of a school nurse is a busy one, but you're taking care of everyone. There's no better motivation.

records.jp: そろそろ私も卒業かぁ。^00ふふ、保健委員生活……^00悪いもんじゃなかったな
records.en_original: I'm closing in on graduation. Life as a school nurse...wasn't too bad, really.
records.en_auxiliary: I'm closing in on graduation. Life in the nurse's office...wasn't too bad, really.
records.en: I'm closing in on graduation. Life as a school nurse...wasn't too bad, really.

records.jp: 今ね、保健だよりを書いてるんだ。^00今回のテーマはずばり……^00って、ここで言っちゃつまらないね、あはは
records.en_original: I'm writing a health newsletter right now. The topic is... I can already see your eyes glazing over. Ahaha...
records.en_auxiliary: I'm writing a health newsletter right now. The topic is... I can already see your eyes glazing over, ahaha.
records.en: I'm writing a health newsletter right now. The topic is... I can already see your eyes glazing over. Ahaha...

records.jp: うーん。毎回テーマを考えるの、^00大変なんだよね……。^00何かいいのないかなぁ……
records.en_original: Hmm... It's hard to come up with a new topic for every newsletter. What would be interesting...?
records.en_auxiliary: Hmm... It's hard to come up with a new topic for every newsletter. What would be interesting?
records.en: Hmm... It's hard to come up with a new topic for every newsletter. What would be interesting...?

records.jp: 健康トリビアなんかは近所のおじいちゃんに^00ヒアリングしに行ってるんだ。^00物知りだからいろんなこと知ってるんだよ
records.en_original: I usually ask my neighbor for health tops. She's very knowledgeable about lots of different things.
records.en_auxiliary: I usually ask my neighbor for health topics. He's very knowledgeable about lots of different things.
records.en: I usually ask my neighbor for health tops. She's very knowledgeable about lots of different things.

records.jp: よーし、今回も無事書き上がったー！^00保健だより、苦労して作ってるんだから^00君もちゃんと読んでよね？
records.en_original: Alright, I'm finally done! The nurse's office put in a lot of effort into this, so make sure you read it!
records.en_auxiliary: All right, I'm finally done! The nurse's office put in a lot of effort into this, so make sure you read it!
records.en: Alright, I'm finally done! The nurse's office put in a lot of effort into this, so make sure you read it!

records.jp: あーいたたたたたた！^00おなかがいたいなー、もう！^00これじゃあ補習とか絶対無理だなー、うん！
records.en_original: Gah! Ow ow ow ow ow! My stomach hurts! Augh! There's no way I can study like this! Absolutely not!
records.en_auxiliary: Gah! Ow ow ow ow ow! My stomach hurts! Augh! There's no way I can study like this! Absolutely not!
records.en: Gah! Ow ow ow ow ow! My stomach hurts! Augh! There's no way I can study like this! Absolutely not!

records.jp: いたたたたた！^00いやー、体育の授業中転んじゃって！^00ひょっとしたら骨折れてるかもなー！
records.en_original: Owwww... I can't believe I fell over in PE! I think I might've broken something!
records.en_auxiliary: Owww... I can't believe I fell over in P.E.! I think I might've broken something!
records.en: Owwww... I can't believe I fell over in PE! I think I might've broken something!

records.jp: ああああ、持病が！^00試験の前になると頭が痛くなるんだよね！^00あー、辛いなー。辛すぎるなー！
records.en_original: Ohhhhh, I'm so sick... My head hurts so much! And before my exam, too! The pain! It's too much to bear!
records.en_auxiliary: Ohhh, I'm so sick... My head hurts so much! And before my exam, too! The pain! It's too much to bear!
records.en: Ohhhhh, I'm so sick... My head hurts so much! And before my exam, too! The pain! It's too much to bear!

records.jp: うう、仮病はよくないね……。^00本当のときに信じてもらえなくなる……。^00うう……げほげほ……
records.en_original: Bluhhh... Whatever you do, don't lie about being sick. They won't believe when you really are. *cough* Ugh...
records.en_auxiliary: Bluhhh... Whatever you do, don't lie about being sick. They won't believe when you really are. *Cough* Ugh...
records.en: Bluhhh... Whatever you do, don't lie about being sick. They won't believe when you really are. *cough* Ugh...

records.jp: 周りが静かすぎてもつまらないよね、^00きっと。気付かせてくれてありがとう
records.en_original: It's no fun when things are too quiet, is it? You helped me realize that.
records.en_auxiliary: It's no fun when things are too quiet, is it? You helped me realize that.
records.en: It's no fun when things are too quiet, is it? You helped me realize that.

records.jp: これからは、断ることも覚えて^00いかなきゃダメだよね
records.en_original: From now on, I have to be able to say no to things.
records.en_auxiliary: From now on, I have to be able to say no to things.
records.en: From now on, I have to be able to say no to things.

records.jp: 私、諦めないことにする。^00やっぱりもっといい絵、描いてみたいし。^00それに……絵を描くのって楽しいからね
records.en_original: I'm not going to give up. There's so much more I want to paint. Besides...painting is fun!
records.en_auxiliary: I'm not going to give up. There's so much more I want to paint. Besides...painting is fun!
records.en: I'm not going to give up. There's so much more I want to paint. Besides...painting is fun!

records.jp: スキンケア！　何がなくともスキンケア！^00輝かしい一生を送るために、^00スキンケアは欠かせないのよ！
records.en_original: Repeat after me: skin care is essential! It's the key to having a bright future!
records.en_auxiliary: Repeat after me: skin care is essential! It's the key to having a bright future!
records.en: Repeat after me: skin care is essential! It's the key to having a bright future!
